title: Define AgentOS lifecycle control map
purpose: Map boot, steady-state, degraded, recovery and update modes to Agent Runtime responsibilities.
scope: Define lifecycle modes for AgentOS operation.
Assign each mode to Agent Runtime, SecurityExecution, agentd, packaging or scripts.
Identify required durable state and operator projection per mode.
Define degraded-mode behavior without external dependencies.
implementation_steps: List runtime events that start or stop each loop.
Record evidence for ownership and expected gates.
acceptance_criteria: Boot mode does not require network or remote model.
Update mode accounts for active ecosystem artifacts.
Operator projection can explain every mode.
verification: Lifecycle map references boot, steady-state, degraded, recovery and update.
failure_modes: Lifecycle depends on model replay as authority.
Degraded mode silently enables side effects.
Update mode ignores active artifact set.
